tasks.title: Parallel Auth Feature: Specs, Core Logic & Unit Tests
tasks.goal: Token validation feature: specification, implementation and tests, built in parallel by BA, DEV and QA.
tasks.interfaceContract:
Module src/auth.js (CommonJS) exports exactly: module.exports = { validateToken }.
Token format: "<userId>.<expiresAtMs>" — userId is 1-64 chars of [A-Za-z0-9_-]; expiresAtMs is a positive integer (milliseconds since epoch).
validateToken(token, nowMs = Date.now()) returns { valid: true, userId } for a good token, otherwise { valid: false, reason } where reason is one of:
  "NOT_A_STRING" (token is not a string), "MALFORMED" (wrong shape, bad userId, bad or non-positive expiresAtMs), "EXPIRED" (expiresAtMs <= nowMs).
Checks run in that order. The function never throws.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/auth-spec.md documents the token format, every reason code, and edge cases.
src/auth.js implements the interface contract exactly and validates its inputs.
tests/auth.test.js covers valid, NOT_A_STRING, MALFORMED and EXPIRED cases and passes with node --test.
src/auth.js and tests/auth.test.js start with a JSDoc block containing @governed-by PO_ARCHITECT (code-craft skill).
tasks.verifyCmd: node -e "const f=require('fs');for(const p of ['docs/auth-spec.md','src/auth.js','tests/auth.test.js'])if(!f.existsSync(p)){console.error('missing '+p);process.exit(1)}for(const p of ['src/auth.js','tests/auth.test.js']){const t=f.readFileSync(p,'utf8').trimStart();if(!t.startsWith('/**')||!t.slice(0,t.indexOf('*/')).includes('@governed-by PO_ARCHITECT')){console.error(p+' lacks the code-craft JSDoc header');process.exit(1)}}" && node --test tests/auth.test.js

subtasks.prompt: Write the token validation specification into docs/auth-spec.md: token format, each reason code, validation order, and edge cases, following the shared interface contract.
Implement validateToken in src/auth.js exactly as the shared interface contract says.
Write tests/auth.test.js using node:test and node:assert that require("../src/auth.js") and cover every case in the shared interface contract. Do not create or edit src/auth.js.
